Summer Associate, Software Engineering

Balyasny Asset Management
View all jobs
Hong Kong SAR
Engineering - Software (Information & Communication Technology)
Full time
Sign in and add your salary to see matches
Posted 1d ago
Apply⁠

Join us for a unique 10-week software engineering internship that provides personal and professional development in a creative collaborative team setting. As a software engineer summer associate, you will solve complex business problems while utilizing the latest technologies. You will have the opportunity to learn about our different business areas, platforms, and teams.

We are looking for creative and enthusiastic software engineers who thrive in a collaborative team setting. In this role, you will:

  • Support your team in the development of software based on agreed projects and platforms
  • Utilize the latest technologies to scale applications
  • Work closely with different teams across platform, infrastructure, engineering, data, investments, finance, and other teams throughout the firm

Minimum qualifications:
  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field with a graduation date of Spring or Summer 2028
  • Proven knowledge of at least one high-level programming language and its framework (Python, C#, C++, Java, etc.)
  • Energetic, technical, and equipped with the skills and knowledge to drive results

Preferred qualifications:
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment
  • Excellent communication, problem solving, and organization skills with a proactive, positive attitude
  • Passion for new technologies through personal projects and commitment to learning new skill

Company profile

Balyasny Asset Management

Financial Investment Services1,001-5,000 employees

Balyasny Asset Management (BAM) is a diversified global investment firm founded in 2001 by Dmitry Balyasny, Scott Schroeder, and Taylor O'Malley. With over $29 billion in assets under management, BAM employs more than 2,300 people across 23 offices in the U.S. and Canada, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. The firm’s investment teams span five strategies, including Equities Long/Short, Fixed Income & Macro, Commodities, Multi-Asset Arbitrage, and Systematic. Balyasny’s mission is to deliver to its investors absolute, uncorrelated returns in all market environments.
